_comment: Sample configuration for Scene Segment Splitter. Copy this and edit per show.

_help.intro_duration: Seconds of shared intro to re-insert at the start of every episode after the first.
_help.auto_target: true = derive the expected boundary from the runtime ((duration+intro)/2). Set false to force target_time.
_help.target_time: Manual expected boundary (seconds) used only when auto_target is false.
_help.time_margin: How far (+/- seconds) from the expected boundary to search.
_help.transition_selection: Smart | Select Latest Transition | Select Earliest Transition
_help.split_point: At Start of Fade | After Fade
_help.detection_method: Comprehensive (All Methods) | Standard Blackdetect Only | Histogram Analysis | Scene Change Detection
_help.on_detection_failure: copy (copy source unsplit) | midpoint (split at derived midpoint) | skip
